name: manual_399a47
claim: Before publishing a Git tree through an API, require the constructed remote tree SHA to equal the locally verified tree SHA; chunk large blobs instead of trusting truncated command output.

decisions.notes: A prior observability commit appeared to delete a massive file set because an incomplete remote tree was constructed from truncated memory content. Exact tree-SHA equality prevented branch publication until the full blobs were recreated.

rationale: A prior observability commit appeared to delete a massive file set because an incomplete remote tree was constructed from truncated memory content. Exact tree-SHA equality prevented branch publication until the full blobs were recreated.
